# freecenter_vm (Resource)

A virtual machine managed by FreeCenter on an ESXi host. Hardware and option changes are applied with the VM powered off: the provider powers it off, applies them and restores the desired power state. Changing host_id migrates the VM to the other host.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datastore` (String) Datastore of the VM folder and disks. Changing it together with host_id chooses the datastore on the target host; changing it alone replaces the VM.
- `host_id` (String) FreeCenter host id (freecenter_host.id or data.freecenter_host.id). Changing it migrates the VM to that host, on the datastore named by datastore: the files are copied directly between the two hosts.
- `name` (String) VM name. It names the folder on the datastore at creation; renaming changes the display name only.

### Optional

- `adapter_type` (String) Type of the network adapters: e1000, e1000e or vmxnet3 (default e1000).
- `additional_networks` (List of String) Port groups of the network adapters after the first, in order. Adapters are added, moved to another port group and removed to match the list; when omitted they are left alone.
- `annotation` (String) VM notes.
- `boot_delay_ms` (Number) Delay before the firmware starts booting, in milliseconds (0-10000).
- `boot_from_cdrom` (Boolean) Boot from the CD/DVD drive first, then from the hard disk. Requires iso_path.
- `clone_from` (String) Create the VM as a clone of this VM or template (its freecenter_vm id). The source must be on host_id and powered off. The other attributes are then applied to the clone.
- `cloud_image` (String) Cloud image on the datastore (e.g. cloud-images/rocky-9.vmdk): the VM boots from a copy of this installed image instead of an empty disk.
- `cloud_init` (Block, Optional) Cloud-init configuration, applied on the first boot of a VM created from cloud_image. Later changes do not reach an existing VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cloud_init))
- `cores_per_socket` (Number) Cores per virtual socket.
- `cpu_hot_add` (Boolean) Allow adding virtual CPUs while the VM runs.
- `disk_sizes_gb` (List of Number) Disk sizes in GB. Disks can grow and be appended; shrinking and removing are not supported. Optional with cloud_image, clone_from and restore_from.
- `disk_thin` (Boolean) Thin provisioning for new disks (default true).
- `firmware` (String) Firmware: bios or efi.
- `guest_id` (String) Guest OS id, e.g. ubuntu64Guest. Required unless the VM is cloned or restored.
- `iso_path` (String) ISO in the CD/DVD drive, e.g. [datastore] isos/ubuntu.iso; an empty string ejects it. With cloud_init it is set automatically to the seed ISO.
- `memory_hot_add` (Boolean) Allow adding memory while the VM runs.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MB (default 2048).
- `migrate_mode` (String) How a running VM is migrated when host_id changes: stop_start (shut down, copy, power on) or suspend (suspend, copy, resume: hosts with the same CPU only); cold for a powered-off VM. By default FreeCenter picks the mode from the power state and the CPUs of the two hosts.
- `migrate_precopy` (Boolean) Migration of a running VM: copy the disks from a temporary snapshot before stopping the VM, to shorten the downtime (default false).
- `migrate_reclaim_thin` (Boolean) Migration: make the copied disks thin again on the target host (default true).
- `nested_hv` (Boolean) Expose hardware-assisted virtualization to the guest (nested hypervisors).
- `network` (String) Port group of the first network adapter. It can be changed in place.
- `num_cpus` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs (default 2).
- `power` (String) Desired power state: on or off (default on; off for a template).
- `restore_from` (String) Create the VM from this backup (a freecenter_backup id). The backup must be on host_id. The other attributes are then applied to the restored VM.
- `scsi_controller` (String) SCSI controller: lsilogic-sas, pvscsi, lsilogic or buslogic (default lsilogic-sas).
- `template` (Boolean) Mark the VM as a template: it cannot be powered on and is meant to be cloned (clone_from).
- `usb_controller` (String) USB controller: usb2, usb3 or an empty string for none.
- `vnc_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the remote VNC console of the VM.
- `vnc_password` (String, Sensitive) VNC password. Requires vnc_enabled.
- `vnc_port` (Number) VNC port (0 = assigned automatically). Requires vnc_enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) FreeCenter VM id (<host_id>/<vm_id>). It changes when the VM is migrated.
- `ip_address` (String) Primary IP address reported by the guest tools, when known.
- `uuid` (String) BIOS UUID of the VM. It can be empty until the VM is powered on for the first time.

<a id="nestedblock--cloud_init"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_init`

Optional:

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the VM.
- `network_config` (String) Network configuration (cloud-init network-config YAML, version 2), e.g. for a static address.
- `packages` (List of String) Packages to install on first boot.
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive) Root password (plain text, set on first boot).
- `runcmd` (List of String) Commands to run on first boot.
- `ssh_authorized_keys` (List of String) SSH public keys of the default user.
- `user_data` (String) Raw cloud-init user-data YAML. Overrides every other field except network_config.
- `users` (Attributes List) Users to create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_init--users))
- `write_files` (Attributes List) Files to write on first boot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_init--write_files))

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_init--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_init.users`

Required:

- `name` (String) User name.

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password (plain text).
- `shell` (String) Login shell.
- `ssh_authorized_keys` (List of String) SSH public keys of the user.
- `sudo` (String) Sudo rule, e.g. ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL.


<a id="nestedatt--cloud_init--write_files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_init.write_files`

Required:

- `content` (String) Content of the file.
- `path` (String) Absolute path of the file.

Optional:

- `owner` (String) Owner, e.g. root:root.
- `permissions` (String) Mode, e.g. 0644.
